thread:
Ivy (Finance): Starting a small experiment: verify invoice previews for new per-token bands but keep legacy customers on shielded rates. Need owners for metering tag, CSV diff, comms, and rollback criteria.

Rohan (Billing): OK. Which cohorts? also will invoice previews include a new column?

Ivy (Finance): Cohorts: legacy-monthly, legacy-annual, and a tiny pilot of high-usage accounts. We'll tag with `acct.meta.pricing_cohort=legacy_shield_v2`. Previews should include `legacy_shield=true` column so CSVs filter easily.

Leah (RevOps): I'll draft copy for preview emails and the in-product banner. For dry-run we should show preview-only text: "No charge applied — preview only." :memo:

Sam (Product): Add `rate_version` to /account and /billing APIs so Console can show exact behavior. Also want a small smoke set to capture system-message-heavy usage.

Diego (Billing Ops): Metering plan: stage will emit `legacy_shield:true` on aggregates. I'll add a feature flag so QA can toggle. Proration rule: annual customers who change mid-cycle stay on legacy until renewal unless they opt in. I'll add logic to invoicer.

Ivy (Finance): Quick runbook outline:
```
- Tag cohorts in staging + sanity check (test-tenant-1)
- Emit `legacy_shield` flag from metering (staging)
- Run 14-day dry reconciliation comparing ledger vs invoice_preview
- Produce sample invoice CSV, include `legacy_shield` and `rate_version`
- Canary 0.5% legacy-monthly for 24h, monitor `invoice_preview_count`, `refunds_count`, and `token_delta_pct`
- Block if refunds_count > 5 or token_delta_pct > 6%
- Rollback plan + customer notif templates ready
```

Rohan (Billing): I'll get the sample CSV by EOD with columns: account_id, billing_period, plan, applied_rate, legacy_shield, invoice_preview_amount, tokens_billed. Will run `csvdiff` against baseline and post results.

Leah (RevOps): Drafts will include FAQ and opt-in flow. Recommend holding off public pricing page until dry-run passes.

BillingBot: Ticket created: FIN-4299 "legacy shield preview + canary" by Ivy (Finance). https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/FIN-4299

Sam (Product): Also please add a tiny eval that simulates long system prompts to catch unexpected token count shifts.

Diego (Billing Ops): Will add reconcile job to flag accounts with >6% token diff and notify `#billing-team` channel.

Ivy (Finance): Meeting tomorrow 09:30 to sign off canary window. Action items: Rohan => CSV sample, Diego => feature flag + emission, Leah => comms drafts, Sam => API field PR. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
